contexts.text: Hate all who do not favour them. AC 2045:2. AC 2057:end. AC 4225. AC 5721. HH 220. HH 290:end.
Acknowledge as neighbour only those who favour and serve them. AC 5028:end.
Whatever favours this good he calls true; and whatever does not favour it he calls false...
If he loves others, it is because they favour him. AC 6667.
Are angry if the Divine does not favour them. AC 9348:7. AR 692:2.
Never willed well to the neighbour, except in so far as he favoured them.
The moment one does not favour the other, there is disjunction.
Not to live for others, except in so far as they favour him and bis pleasures.
Everyone explains the laws of doctrine in his own favour.
If he explains it in his own favour... he profanes truth.
Desire... to destroy those who do not favour them; for in proportion as anyone loves himself, he hates those who do not favour him. AC 7370.
Apply the things of intelligence in favour of evil.
It is a kind of consent and approval from within... When there is approval, the mind is at rest...
Are explained in favour of his own dominion...
Under Falsity, see this reference.
If truths are falsified to favour evil...
They call that truth which favours the fallacies of the senses, and that good which favours concupiscences.
In enmities against all who do not favour them... HH 587:2.
Apply in favour of their cupidities.
Truths are what favour these goods.
They wished to act according to favour...
Love calls all those things its goods which favour it...
a. [4]. On those who favour sins...
They are for the sake of various favours...
If favour does not cease with the wife...
If she perseveres in chaste favour towards him...
These pledges are first favours...
As the understanding afterwards either favours or does not favour them.
In proportion as the understanding favours evils, the man appropriates them... Favour is consent...
Occurs. SE 4887.
